name: Nostalgic ★ Summer
original_name: ノスタルジック★さまぁ
source:
Aoto, a 30-year-old freelancer, suddenly met a girl.
She was carrying a piece of paper with one word written on it: "This is your child".
The story takes place on the peninsula in the countryside called Cape Mountain Township.
It is also the place where Aoto has fond memories of spending a summer as a child.
translation:
30岁的自由职业者青藤突然认识了一位女孩。
她手里拿着一张纸，上面写着一个字：“这是你的孩子”。
故事发生在一个名叫开普山镇的乡村半岛上。
这里也是青户童年度过夏天的美好回忆的地方。
